desc: Test the closed-form formula ans = (N-1)!·Σ_x x·(T − 10^{len(x)}) against brute force for small N; confirmed WRONG (N=3 gives 72 vs 1332), as predicted by the non-separability of 10^{a+b}.
Implement the subset-sum formulation: ans = Σ_d σ_d · Σ_K K!(N−1−K)!·g^(d)_K, where H(z)=Π_d(1+w_d z)^{c_d}, g^(d)=H/(1+w_d z), w_d=10^d mod p, σ_d=sum of d-digit numbers in [1,N].
Implement mod-998244353 convolution via numpy FFT with 15-bit split (4 rfft + 3 irfft per convolution, round to int64, recombine mod p); multiply the ≤6 group polynomials sequentially.
Compute each g^(d) from H by O(N) recurrence g_K = h_K − w_d·g_{K−1}; accumulate term_d = Σ_K fact[K]·fact[N−1−K]·g_K and ans = Σ σ_d·term_d mod p.

Verify solution: N=3 → 1332 traced exactly (matches sample 1); N=1 → 1 edge case verified; formula cross-validated against brute force for N≤10; FFT precision safe (partial sums < 2^47 ≪ 2^53); runtime at N=200000 estimated ~1.5–2s (factorials O(N), 5 FFT convolutions max size 2^19, 6 O(N) division passes).
